content: Certainly. 1. Adjust the dose of resmetirom when co-administered with moderate CYP2C8 inhibitors, as resmetirom is a substrate of CYP2C8. Monitor therapy closely to avoid potential adverse effects. 2. Resmetirom can increase the systemic levels or effects of simvastatin due to its inhibition of BCRP and OATP1B1/3 transporters. Monitor for statin-related adverse reactions, such as elevated liver enzymes, myopathy, or rhabdomyolysis. Limit the daily dosage of statins as per clinical guidelines. 3.
